title: Toledo Concrete Classic 2026
body:
The Toledo Concrete Classic returned for another incredible year, drawing over 90 skaters from across Northwest Ohio and beyond. Four age divisions — Mini (under 10), Junior (10–13), Teen (14–17), and Open — kept the crowd on their feet all day at Erie Street Market.

First place in the Teen division went to ODA regular Marcus T., who laid down a clean kickflip-to-manual combo that had the judges nodding. The Open division podium was swept by three riders from the Toledo metro area — a testament to how deep the local scene has gotten.

Every participant received new hardware courtesy of our sponsor partners, and concessions were provided free of charge to all youth under 18. We couldn't do this without the community showing up every year. See you at the next one.
